en.does_not_prove: The signature remains mathematically valid for the signed revision; this does not show who made the later changes or whether the signer agreed to them. Compare the signed revision with the final one.
en.shows: Signature Signature1 covers an earlier revision; revision(s) 3, added afterwards, change page content or document structure, which the signature does not cover.
en.title: Content changed after signing

en.does_not_prove: The classification of changes is heuristic and some PDF viewers apply permissions differently; this shows a conflict with the declared permissions, not intent.
en.shows: Signature Signature1 certifies the document with permission level 2 (1 = no changes, 2 = form filling and signing, 3 = also annotations), but revision(s) 3 contain changes outside that level.
en.title: Changes not allowed by the certification signature

en.does_not_prove: Incremental saving is normal when a PDF is filled in, signed, annotated or re-saved by many programs; it does not show who changed the file or that a change was improper.
en.shows: The file contains 3 revisions: the original save plus later updates appended to the end of the file. Each earlier version can be extracted and compared.
en.title: Incremental updates

en.does_not_prove: Metadata dates are written by the editing software from the computer clock and can be set freely; the gap does not prove when the changes were really made or by whom.
en.shows: Revision 3 is dated 3 d 0 h 0 min after revision 2 (according to their modification dates).
en.title: Time gap between revisions

en.does_not_prove: This tool does not validate the certificate chain, revocation or the signer's identity; a signature can be technically intact and still come from an untrusted or self-made certificate.
en.shows: The file contains signature Signature1, signed by O=Rakvor TEST,CN=Ana Ruiz (TEST examiner). Its byte coverage and cryptographic integrity are reported separately.
en.title: Digital signature present (trust not verified)

en.does_not_prove: Incremental updates are normal when forms are filled, documents are signed or comments are added. It does not show who made the change, when, or with what intent.
en.shows: Rendering revision 2 and revision 3 gives different images on page(s) 1 (largest changed share 0.000314); pages added: -; pages removed: -. The changed areas are outlined in the comparison images.
en.title: Visible change between revisions

text.en: The document was saved 3 times; the last change was made 3 days after creation. This information comes from the document itself and is not proof on its own.

en.next_step: Do not rely on this file until the examiner has explained the problem.
en.summary: The file could not be fully examined or shows a serious problem.
